title: NIST WebBook: Citric acid is C6H8O7, molecular weight 192.1235 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Citric acid as C6H8O7, molecular weight 192.1235 amu, CAS 77-92-9.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Citric acid, CAS Registry Number 77-92-9, lists molecular formula C6H8O7 and molecular weight 192.1235 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 192.0270026 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/C6H8O7/c7-3(8)1-6(13,5(11)12)2-4(9)10/h13H,1-2H2,(H,7,8)(H,9,10)(H,11,12). The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
